applies_to: All saved v2 result files; supplementary interpretation without modifying estimates or frozen run files.
independence_scope: A/B sides are independent within each replicate pair; eight replicate pairs within each run use distinct fixed seeds. control1 and v2_round1 share tag suffix 1 and seed namespace, so cross-run coupling is possible despite different L/sample counts. v2_round3 uses suffix 3 and different seeds from control1. Old/new repair comparisons intentionally share seeds.
winner_tie_scope: Only exactly equal computed floating scores use the smaller R. Mathematical ties or arbitrary near score ties are not symbolically or interval certified. Structural c=0 band tie resolution is separate and does not certify all winner ties.
